mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_online_session (acct_session_id, username_mask, mac, nas_ip, framed_ip, vlan_id, status) VALUES (#{acctSessionId}, #{usernameMask}, #{mac}, #{nasIp}, #{framedIp}, #{vlanId}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username_mask = VALUES(username_mask), mac = VALUES(mac), nas_ip = VALUES(nasIp), framed_ip = VALUES(framedIp), vlan_id = VALUES(vlan_id), status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_online_session SET status = 0 WHERE acct_session_id = #{acctSessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, acct_session_id, username_mask, mac, nas_ip, framed_ip, vlan_id, status, start_time, update_time FROM sys_online_session WHERE acct_session_id = #{acctSessionId} LIMIT 1
